text: The Fix (The Unlock): DeltaFosB does fade on its own, but slowly, and the same fears keep making more. So we use "System Reformats" (Shrooms/Iboga). Iboga raised GDNF, a growth factor that protects dopamine neurons, in rats (He, et al, 2005), and one dose of psilocybin grew new connections in mouse brains that lasted a month (Shao, et al, 2021). Whether either loosens DeltaFosB's hold hasn't been tested.
reader: someone with trauma or in withdrawal who is anxious, wired, numb or foggy, wanting to know what is going on in their brain and which of the protocol's tools does what
